title: chat-server: expiry sweep skips Chat unreadCount change
description: sweep_expired (src/expiry.rs) hard-deletes Messages via ChatBackend::expire_message but never calls chat::record_unread_count_changes, unlike Message/set destroy and read-and-burn. Chat.unreadCount (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L547-548) drops for the expired Message's Chat, yet Chat state does not advance (RFC 8620 §5.1). Found while implementing JMAP-y3f2.15 (whose Message replyCount change is recorded inside the backend and so covers expiry).
close_reason: Committed and adversarially verified (batch 7); CI at 84a9b7bc
